I'm noticing that you all have many default versions of roles. (e.g. front end developer for react, angular, vue.js, etc.) What do you consider best practice 
for when to create a new test versus create a variant of the test? What are the advantages and disadvantages of using variants?
Subject:
When should I create a variant versus
 have a different test?
Response: To determine whether to create a new test or a variant of an existing test, consider the purpose of the assessment and the skills being evaluated . If you need to assess different candidate profiles or roles, such as front-end developers for React, Angular, or Vue.js, creating test variants may be the best approach . Test variants allow you to create a single assessment that adapts to different candidate profiles, eliminating the need to manage separate tests and improving efficiency . However, if the skills or roles being assessed are significantly different, creating a new test may be more appropriate .
